query: I'm evaluating an 84-year-old woman. Among women 79–89 with community‑acquired or aspiration pneumonia, report in‑hospital mortality by LOS (≤7 vs >7) and day‑1 ICU, plus mech vent, vasopressor, and RRT prevalence.
final_sql: SELECT p.gender, p.anchor_age, p.anchor_year, p.anchor_year_group, d.deathtime, i.intime, i.outtime, s.stay_id, s.first_careunit, s.last_careunit, l.value, l.valueuom, m.value, m.valueuom, v.value, v.valueuom, r.value, r.valueuom, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.value <= 7 AND i.intime <= i.outtime AND s.first_careunit = 'ICU' AND m.value = 'mechanical ventilation' AND v.value = 'vasopressor' AND r.value = 'RRT' THEN a.subject_id END) AS survivors FROM patients p JOIN admissions a ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id JOIN icustays s ON s.subject_id = a.subject_id JOIN chartevents c ON c.subject_id = a.subject_id AND c.charttime BETWEEN s.intime AND s.outtime JOIN labevents l ON l.subject_id = a.subject_id AND l.charttime BETWEEN c.charttime AND c.storetime JOIN microbiologyevents m ON m.subject_id = a.subject_id AND m.charttime BETWEEN c.charttime AND c.storetime JOIN inputevents v ON v.subject_id = a.subject_id AND v.starttime BETWEEN c.charttime AND c.storetime AND v.orderid IN (SELECT orderid FROM poe_detail WHERE attribute_name = 'RRT') LEFT JOIN (SELECT subject_id, deathtime FROM admissions WHERE deathtime IS NOT NULL) d ON d.subject_id = a.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 79 AND 89 AND c.itemid IN (SELECT itemid FROM d_labitems WHERE label = 'pneumonia') GROUP BY p.gender, p.anchor_age, p.anchor_year, p.anchor_year_group, d.deathtime, i.intime, i.outtime, s.stay_id, s.first_careunit, s.last_careunit, l.value, l.valueuom, m.value, m.valueuom, v.value, v.valueuom, r.value, r.valueuom;
